title: Campaign1 Target Feasibility
objective: Deliver a reproducible checked-in target-feasibility harness for the exact hyperelliptic bounded modular character scan, producing 11 ABBA generic/V8/Wasm measurements with exact factors, guard/copy/publication accounting, C-to-Wasm provenance, and explicit unavailability rather than skips

oracles: independent CPython point-count factors for p=5003,10009,20011

handoff.summary: Added an exact reviewed-phase feasibility harness for the current generic hyperelliptic normalization-factor implementation, a checked scalar V8 target, and a runtime C-to-Wasm target. The standard run emits 11 deterministic ABBA pairs per target, an independent CPython point-count oracle, differential output digests, guard/fallback/interrupt/publication audits, threshold probes, copy accounting, and source-to-Wasm compile/module/instantiate provenance. Wasm remains an explicitly inconclusive production target because its resident phase wins while its runtime Clang path loses; no production compiler route is claimed.
risks: The integration lane must classify bench/optimizer-workloads/modular-scan-target.c as benchmark-reference in architecture/native-code.json before architecture:check can pass; that shared registry is outside this lane's claims.

The lane base predates the final hyperelliptic workload/catalog identities, so integration must rerun the standard harness after cherry-pick to bind the final workload sha256:7df121d9b9a4dfa273e93073d4484609d1fa8f3c878206711bb04ab5ea32ea5b and catalog sha256:ae1110def261664ed55b4ff13b5c0b16e4190e02938ae58629f8ae877cb41714.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this lane commit into integration and add the agreed benchmark-reference native-code registry entry.

Run node bench/optimizer-workloads/modular-scan-target-feasibility.cjs --output /scratch/sagejs-campaign1/evidence/target-feasibility/modular-scan-target-feasibility.integrated.json against the integrated catalog.

Assemble opportunity evidence with the adapter baseline as baselineId, feasibleLowerBound V8 as feasibleLowerBoundId, Wasm negativeTargets as an inconclusive negativeId, and the separately rerun warm public profile as attributionId.
